summary_zh: 面向训练与推理的 GPU 集群租赁与调度服务。
summary_en: Rental and orchestration of GPU clusters for AI training and inference.
why_new_zh: AI 训练/推理对算力需求爆发，催生独立于传统云的算力新云品类。
why_new_en: Exploding compute demand for AI training and inference created a 'neocloud' category independent of traditional cloud providers.

summary_zh: 优化大模型推理的延迟、吞吐与成本的中间层（服务、编译、量化）。
summary_en: The middle layer that optimizes LLM inference latency, throughput, and cost — serving, compilation, quantization.
why_new_zh: 模型部署成本高，推理优化成为独立且高价值的工具与服务品类。
why_new_en: High deployment costs turned inference optimization into a standalone, high-value tools and services category.

summary_zh: 存储与检索向量嵌入，为 RAG 等检索增强应用提供基础设施。
summary_en: Stores and retrieves vector embeddings, powering RAG and other retrieval-augmented applications.
why_new_zh: RAG 与语义检索普及，使向量存储从功能变为独立基础设施品类。
why_new_en: The spread of RAG and semantic search turned vector storage from a feature into its own infrastructure category.

summary_zh: 生成人工数据用于训练/微调，缓解真实数据稀缺与隐私限制。
summary_en: Generates artificial data for training and fine-tuning, easing real-data scarcity and privacy constraints.
why_new_zh: 高质量训练数据接近枯竭，合成数据成为新的数据供给品类。
why_new_en: With high-quality training data running out, synthetic data became a new supply category of its own.

summary_zh: 构建、编排、监控自主 AI Agent 的框架与运行时（工具调用、记忆、评估）。
summary_en: Frameworks and runtimes for building, orchestrating, and monitoring autonomous AI agents — tool use, memory, evaluation.
why_new_zh: Agent 从单次问答转向多步自主执行，需要全新的编排与观测基础设施。
why_new_en: As agents moved from single-turn Q&A to multi-step autonomy, an entirely new orchestration and observability stack became necessary.

summary_zh: 检测 AI 生成内容、添加水印与溯源，服务教育、媒体与合规场景。
summary_en: Detects AI-generated content and adds watermarking and provenance, serving education, media, and compliance.
why_new_zh: 生成内容泛滥带来真实性与版权问题，催生检测与溯源工具市场。
why_new_en: The flood of generated content raised authenticity and copyright problems, spawning a detection and provenance tooling market.
